parties.petitioner: Kerala State Beverages Manufacturing & Marketing Corporation Ltd.
parties.respondent: The Assistant Commissioner of Income Tax Circle 1(1)

summary: Key issues involved the applicability of Section 40(a)(iib) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 to disallow deductions for gallonage fee, licence fee, shop rental (kist), and surcharge on sales tax paid by a state government undertaking. The High Court held that while fees under FL-9 licences were exclusively levied on the state undertaking and thus disallowable, those under FL-1 licences were not exclusive and surcharge on sales tax did not qualify as a 'fee or charge' under the provision. The Supreme Court considered arguments on the interpretation of 'exclusively levied' and whether the statutory amendments targeted only state-linked entities. Issue of deductibility of surcharge on sales tax was central.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed in part; the matter remanded to Assessing Officer to reconsider the tax liability consistent with the High Court’s findings, affording opportunity of hearing.
